test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Electrician) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements is/are correct?

Statement I - The annealing process uses heat to reduce the hardness and increase the ductility and toughness of various steels, cast iron, and alloys.

Statement II - Quenching is a rapid cooling process that alters specific properties of materials by manipulating the cooling rate.

options.text: Statement (I) is correct but Statement (II) is incorrect.
Statement (I) is incorrect but Statement (II) is correct.

solution:
**Annealing:** Annealing involves heating a material to a suitable temperature and then cooling it slowly. This process:

 
• Reduces hardness
 
• Increases ductility and toughness
 
• Relieves internal stresses

**Quenching: **Quenching involves rapid cooling (using water, oil, air, etc.) after heating. It:

 
• Controls microstructure formation
 
• Increases hardness and strength
 
• Alters material properties by changing the cooling rate

Statement (I) and Statement (II) both are correct.
